clue.text: See 19 across
See 10
17 cool champion wave rider can be slippery

parts.note: 17 is ULTRA, and ultra cool is icy
a champion surfer is a surf ace

explanation.surface: A very cool champion surfer may find the going slippery.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue borrows 17 across, ULTRA, to make 'ultra cool', meaning freezing.
explanation.definitionFit: A frozen ground or road is a well-known slip hazard, so the phrase names something that can be slippery.

clue.text: Heard one crowing after the 5th bone?

indicators.note: heard says the word is taken by how it sounds when spoken

parts.note: one crowing is a cock, and what comes after the 5th is six

explanation.surface: A puzzled listener asks whether a rooster crowed after the fifth, a bone of contention.
explanation.definitionFit: The tailbone at the base of the spine is the bone this anatomical name refers to.

clue.text: Singing note, perhaps madly in love? On the contrary

parts.note: a PS, postscript, is a note added to a letter

indicators.note: in signals one piece placed inside another
the reverse of madly in love: love goes in the rearranged madly
perhaps says the letters of madly may be arranged another way

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: A singing note sounds as if it is madly in love, or the opposite.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On the contrary' flips the order of 'madly in love': O goes inside ALMDY, the rearrangement of MADLY that 'perhaps' signals.
explanation.definitionFit: Psalmody is the singing of psalms, so the word describes a kind of singing.

clue.text: Greek campaigner gets a German agreement, sealed with a kiss

parts.note: ja is German for yes
X stands for a kiss at the end of a letter

explanation.surface: A Greek politician gets a German to agree, then seals the deal with a kiss.
explanation.definitionFit: Ajax was a Greek warrior who fought in the Trojan War, a campaigner in that sense.

clue.text: Asked for paper in conclusion

indicators.note: the paper measure is placed in the word for conclusion

parts.note: a conclusion is an end
a quire is a quantity of paper, 24 or 25 sheets

explanation.surface: Someone requested paper at the end of things.
explanation.definitionFit: To enquire is to ask, so the past tense matches 'asked'.

clue.text: Said compiler's going to Skye?

indicators.note: said signals that the word is spoken and another spelling is heard

parts.note: the compiler is I, and 'I am going to' is I'll

explanation.surface: The setter says they are going to the Scottish island of Skye.
explanation.definitionFit: Skye is an example of an island off the west coast of Scotland.

clue.text: Press angry with decoration

parts.note: to iron clothes is to press them
cross means angry

explanation.surface: Pressing a garment angrily alongside some ornament.
explanation.definitionFit: The German military medal of that name is a decoration for bravery.

clue.text: Member of the 27 25 makes love again in pyjamas returned after the New Year

indicators.note: the rest of the wordplay is placed after the month's abbreviation

parts.note: January opens the new year, abbreviated JAN
as in 'two and two makes four', makes means is

indicators.note: the word for love and the filled nightwear are read backwards

parts.note: love is nil, nothing, in tennis scoring

indicators.note: the second love goes inside the nightwear

parts.note: PJ is short for pyjamas
again means love a second time, now as O, the zero-shaped score

explanation.surface: A club member keeps making love again in their pyjamas, back after New Year.
explanation.walkthrough: The 27 25 is the 27 Club, musicians who died aged 27. 'Love' is used twice: as nil, then 'again' as the zero-shaped letter.
explanation.definitionFit: The blues-rock singer died in 1970 aged twenty-seven, so belongs to the 27 Club of musicians.

clue.text: New York island where musician stripped

indicators.note: stripped means the outer layer, first and last letters, is taken off

parts.note: a cellist is a musician

explanation.surface: A musician took their clothes off on an island in New York.
explanation.definitionFit: This island in New York harbour was the immigration station for millions arriving in America.

clue.text: A bit of a bloomer, but almost exactly restored

indicators.note: restored means the letters are put back in a new order
almost means one letter short; here it is the T that goes

explanation.surface: Someone describes a slip-up, though one nearly put right.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A bloomer' looks like a mistake, but it is a flower. 'Almost' drops a T from EXACTLY, not the usual last letter, to leave EXACLY to mix with BUT.
explanation.definitionFit: This tube is part of a flower's structure, and a flower is something that blooms.

clue.text: See 24 down
See 19 across
Taken regularly, home run very easy and works

indicators.note: regularly says every other letter is used, here the second, fourth and so on

explanation.surface: A baseball home run, taken regularly, makes for very easy work.
explanation.definitionFit: A French borrowing for an artist's body of output, here in the plural meaning works.

clue.text: Broke, alas, and ruined with no money

indicators.note: broke means the letters are broken up and rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone is penniless, sadly, and ruined.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Broke' looks like the definition (penniless), but it is the signal to rearrange; the definition is at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone unpaid gets no wages, so works with no money coming in.

clue.text: See 17
Our last lousy Hamburger and it gets picked up by dogs

definitions.text: it gets picked up by dogs

indicators.note: lousy means poor or rotten, so the letters are badly arranged

parts.note: a person from Hamburg would say und, German for and

explanation.surface: Our final rotten burger is picked up by dogs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hamburger' looks like food but means someone from Hamburg, whose word for 'and' is German.
explanation.definitionFit: Dogs can hear high-pitched sounds beyond human hearing, as with a dog whistle.

clue.text: Homer's work reported how the divine is justified

indicators.note: reported means the phrase is given as spoken, heard rather than spelt

parts.note: Homer's epic poem about Odysseus's journey home

explanation.surface: A report on Homer's poem explains how the gods are justified.
explanation.definitionFit: Theodicy is the philosophical defence of God's goodness despite the existence of evil.

clue.text: A drink at mine for member of the 27 25

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: the drink is placed at, that is within, the home the clue calls mine

parts.note: in British speech 'at mine' means at my house, so mine stands for MY HOUSE
wine is a drink

explanation.surface: Someone offers a drink at their place to a member of a club.
explanation.walkthrough: The 27 25 is the 27 Club (25 down), the musicians who died aged 27. In British slang 'come round to mine' means my house, which is split to hold the drink.
explanation.definitionFit: The singer died in 2011 at twenty-seven, making her one of the so-called 27 Club of musicians.

clue.text: A room to have often uniquely screened European premieres

definitions.text: A room to have often uniquely screened European premieres

indicators.note: premieres are firsts, so the first letter of each preceding word is taken

explanation.surface: A cinema room that often shows unique European films first.
explanation.definitionFit: An independent cinema of this kind typically screens foreign and European films, often uniquely.

clue.text: Holy man had us abused

indicators.note: abused means mistreated, so the letters are mangled into a new order

explanation.surface: A holy man has swindled or mistreated us.
explanation.definitionFit: A sadhu is a Hindu ascetic or wandering holy man.

clue.text: One's happy in one's earth, perhaps

definitions.meaning: the idiom 'in one's ...' means happy and at ease
earth is one of the four classical ..., alongside air, fire and water

explanation.surface: A person is content in their own soil.
explanation.definitionFit: The word completes an idiom for being at ease and also names a classical substance like earth.

clue.text: Put together the beginnings of scientific programme designed to capture parasites

indicators.note: the first letters surround and hold the parasites
the beginnings are the first letters of the three words that follow

parts.note: lice are parasites

explanation.surface: A science programme is put together to trap parasites.
explanation.definitionFit: To splice is to join pieces such as rope or film, so spliced means joined.

clue.text: Finally, smile is included in English service in return for the magic word

indicators.note: in return says the assembled letters are read from the back
the last letter of smile goes inside the church service

parts.note: a Mass is a church service

indicators.note: finally picks the last letter of smile

explanation.surface: Smile at the end of an English service and say the magic word.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In return' reads backwards EMASES, which is E plus MASS with E inside.
explanation.definitionFit: 'Open sesame' is the magic password in the tale of Ali Baba and the forty thieves.

clue.text: See 27
Prudent to cross street with the Spanish: that would be just delicious

indicators.note: to cross out is to delete, so the street and the Spanish article are struck out

parts.note: el is Spanish for the

explanation.surface: Crossing a street with a Spaniard would be a delicious, prudent move.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cross' looks like 'walk over' but means cross out: strike ST and EL from JUST DELICIOUS.
explanation.definitionFit: Judicious means showing good judgement, a synonym of prudent.

clue.text: Member of the 27 25 sees chicken cross one road back onto the first motorway junction?

indicators.note: the rest of the wordplay is placed onto, after, the junction letters

parts.note: Britain's first motorway is the M1, and its first junction is J1, so J1 M1 read as letters
a hen is a chicken

indicators.note: back says one and road are read in reverse

parts.note: one is I in Roman numerals
X is the shape of a cross

explanation.surface: A chicken crosses a road and backs onto a motorway junction.
explanation.walkthrough: The M1 is a motorway from London to Yorkshire. 'Back' turns I and RD into DRI. 'Sees' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The guitarist died in 1970 at twenty-seven, putting him in the 27 Club of musicians.

clue.text: Staff card

definitions.meaning: a staff is a stout stick or cudgel
one of the four playing-card suits, shown as a black trefoil

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a heavy stick to wield and a playing card of a certain suit.

clue.text: Cut short regret and cycle to reach maker of puzzle

indicators.note: cut short says each word loses its last letter

parts.note: to rue is to regret
a bike is a cycle

explanation.surface: Someone abandons a bike ride and goes to find the puzzle maker.
explanation.definitionFit: Ernő Rubik invented the famous coloured cube puzzle.

clue.text: Weekend incubator prepared for member of the 27 25

parts.note: the end of the word week is its last letter, K

indicators.note: prepared means made ready, so the letters are reworked

explanation.surface: An incubator is made ready at the weekend for a club member.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Weekend' looks like Saturday and Sunday but gives the last letter of week.
explanation.definitionFit: The Nirvana singer died in 1994 at twenty-seven, so he is counted in the 27 Club.

clue.text: Dilemma caused partly by Las Vegas rival

indicators.note: partly says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A dilemma arises partly because of a rival to Las Vegas.
explanation.definitionFit: The Chinese territory is the world's biggest gambling hub, a rival to the Nevada casino city.

clue.text: From whom 1 left, drowning in sad memories

indicators.note: the letter for left is sunk inside the rearranged memories
sad means sorry or bad, so the letters are in a poor order

explanation.surface: Someone left, drowning their sorrows in sad memories.
explanation.walkthrough: 1 is 1 down, WINE: the definition means the person you get wine from.
explanation.definitionFit: A wine waiter is the restaurant figure who serves the bottle, the one from whom it comes.
